name: io.github.mgcrea/mcp-apple-reminders
title: Apple Reminders
description: Search, read and act on Apple Reminders — lists, due dates, writes off by default

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_REMINDERS_ALLOW_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Register the mutating tools. Off by default, and the gate decides whether the write tools exist at all rather than merely refusing — an agent with writes off cannot see them.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_REMINDERS_LISTS
environmentVariables.description: Restrict every read and write to these Reminders lists, by name.
